Name: Mizu's Many Animals Item Bag
Author: ragbonehair
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mizu has made so many lovely animal mods recently, and this is a bag for the item bags mod to hold all of the collected items the animals produce or drop! If you use the optional Animal Husbandry files for the animal mods that produce and cooked dishes will also be included.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You don't have to have all the mods installed, the bag will adjust to the ones you do have. (Though I recommend you have a few!)[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The bags are available to buy from Marnie.[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Download this file, unpack the zip and drop the .json file into your mods folder under Item Bags/assets/modded bags.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5382]Item Bags[/url] and its requirements.[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]At least one of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods]Mizu's animal mods[/url].[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
All credit to the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods]Mizu[/url], who has made so many wonderful mods.
And to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SlayerDharok/mods]SlayerDharok[/url] for the essential Item Bags mod.
